topics.titleTr: CI'da Yuk Testi: Regresyonlari Erken Yakalayin
topics.titleEn: Load Testing in CI: Catch Regressions Early
topics.angle: how-to | wire performance tests into the pipeline so latency regressions fail the build
topics.brief: Outline: why one-off load tests miss slow creep; picking a tool (k6, Gatling, Locust) and writing a smoke-sized scenario; running it against ephemeral preview environments; defining thresholds and SLO-based pass/fail so a regression breaks CI; keeping runs fast and non-flaky; trending p95/p99 over time. Claims to verify: k6 thresholds and CI exit codes; realistic CI-sized load vs full stress tests. Sources: k6 docs (grafana.com/docs/k6); Gatling docs. Emphasize gating on relative regression, not absolute numbers.

topics.titleTr: Anahtarsiz CI: Uzun Omurlu Sir Yerine OIDC
topics.titleEn: Keyless CI: Use OIDC Instead of Long-Lived Secrets
topics.angle: how-to | replace stored cloud keys in CI with short-lived OIDC tokens
topics.brief: Outline: why long-lived cloud keys in CI are a top breach vector; how OIDC federation works (CI issues a signed token, cloud trusts it, mints short-lived creds); step-by-step for GitHub Actions to AWS/GCP/Azure with scoped trust conditions; locking trust to repo, branch and environment; pitfalls (over-broad subjects, forks). Claims to verify: current GitHub OIDC claims and cloud trust-policy syntax. Sources: GitHub Actions OIDC docs; AWS IAM roles for GitHub OIDC. Include a least-privilege checklist and audit tips.

topics.titleTr: Kubernetes RBAC: En Az Yetki Ilkesini Uygulayin
topics.titleEn: Kubernetes RBAC: Least-Privilege Access Done Right
topics.angle: checklist | design Roles, bindings and service accounts that grant only what is needed
topics.brief: Outline: RBAC primitives (Role vs ClusterRole, RoleBinding, ServiceAccount) in plain terms; common over-grants (cluster-admin, wildcard verbs, default SA tokens); a least-privilege recipe per workload and per human; auditing with kubectl auth can-i and tools like rbac-tool; pairing RBAC with namespaces and admission policy. Claims to verify: default service-account token behaviour in current Kubernetes, aggregated ClusterRoles. Sources: kubernetes.io RBAC authorization docs; CNCF security guidance. Deliver as an actionable hardening checklist, distinct from the eBPF and policy-as-code posts.

topics.titleTr: 2026: Yazarlik Icin Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini
topics.titleEn: Claude vs ChatGPT vs Gemini for Writing in 2026
topics.angle: comparison | which assistant fits drafting, editing and long-form work
topics.brief: Outline: a fair test across tasks writers actually do (first drafts, line editing, tone matching, long-form structure, fact-checking, style memory); where each model shines and stumbles; voice and over-polishing tendencies; context limits for book-length work; custom instructions/projects for a persistent style guide; privacy for client work. Claims to verify: current context windows and memory features for Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini. Sources: docs.claude.com; model release notes. Keep it writing-specific and reproducible, distinct from the creator and spreadsheet comparisons already published.

topics.titleTr: Junior Gelistiricilere Iyi Mentorluk Nasil Yapilir
topics.titleEn: How to Mentor Junior Developers Well
topics.angle: guide | help new engineers grow fast without doing the work for them
topics.brief: Outline: what juniors need now that AI writes boilerplate (judgment, debugging, reading code, asking good questions); structuring the first 90 days; code review as teaching, not gatekeeping; pairing and the 'struggle budget'; giving feedback that builds autonomy; measuring growth. A short story of a stuck junior and a better intervention. Claims to verify: entry-level hiring pressure and the shift in junior tasks from 2026 labour data. Sources: Stanford HAI AI Index 2026; LinkedIn Economic Graph engineer report. Pair with the junior-to-senior roadmap post.

topics.titleTr: Ilk Acik Kaynak Katkinizi Nasil Yaparsiniz
topics.titleEn: Make Your First Open-Source Contribution
topics.angle: how-to | go from reader to merged PR without the intimidation
topics.brief: Outline: why contributing beats another side project for your portfolio and network; finding beginner-friendly issues (good-first-issue, docs, tests); reading CONTRIBUTING and setting up locally; scoping a small first PR; writing a clear description and responding to review; handling rejection gracefully; building a streak. Mention using AI to understand an unfamiliar codebase without pasting secrets. Claims to verify: current good-first-issue norms and CLA/DCO basics. Sources: opensource.guide; GitHub docs on contributing. Keep it encouraging and concrete, with a first-week plan.

topics.titleTr: Video Icin Yapay Zeka Seslendirme: Araclar, Etik
topics.titleEn: AI Voiceovers for Video: Tools and Ethics
topics.angle: guide | produce natural narration for shorts without a mic or a pro VO budget
topics.brief: Outline: where AI narration genuinely works (faceless explainers, localization, accessibility) and where a real voice still wins; a quick workflow (script, generate, pace to b-roll, caption); comparing options on naturalness, languages and licensing; the ethics and rules (disclosure, voice cloning consent, platform synthetic-media labels); keeping a consistent channel voice. Claims to verify: current platform AI-content labeling rules (TikTok, YouTube, Instagram) and voice-clone consent norms. Sources: YouTube and TikTok synthetic-media/labeling policies. Distinct from the faceless-AI-content and avatar posts.

topics.titleTr: 2026 Icerik Uretici Geliri: 6 Kazanc Yolu
topics.titleEn: Creator Monetization in 2026: 6 Income Streams
topics.angle: guide | diversify beyond platform payouts without burning out your audience
topics.brief: Outline: why platform ad payouts are volatile and how top creators stack income; six streams (brand deals/UGC, memberships/subscriptions, digital products, affiliates, services/consulting, live shopping) with rough effort-vs-return and when each makes sense at different audience sizes; sequencing them; owning the audience via email/DM lists. Claims to verify: current creator-fund/payout terms and any 2026 program changes across YouTube, TikTok, Instagram. Sources: platform creator-monetization help pages; a 2026 creator economy report. Complement existing single-stream posts (TikTok Shop, digital products) rather than repeat them.

topics.titleTr: DM ve Yorumlari Yapay Zeka ile Olcekte Yonetin
topics.titleEn: Handle DMs and Comments at Scale With AI
topics.angle: how-to | triage and reply to social inboxes fast while keeping a human voice
topics.brief: Outline: the hidden cost of unanswered DMs and comments (reach, trust, lost sales); a triage system (auto-sort questions, leads, support, spam); drafting on-brand replies with a saved brand-voice prompt and approving before send; saved replies and routing to a human for anything sensitive; measuring response time and conversion. Guardrails against tone-deaf auto-replies and FTC/disclosure issues. Claims to verify: native creator inbox tools and third-party options; platform automation limits. Sources: platform business/creator inbox docs. Keep a human-in-the-loop stance, distinct from the no-code support-chatbot post.

topics.titleTr: Icerigi Yapay Zeka ile Dogru Sekilde Yerellestirin
topics.titleEn: Localize Your Content With AI, the Right Way
topics.angle: how-to | translate and adapt marketing content for new markets without sounding machine-made
topics.brief: Outline: translation vs localization (idioms, tone, currency, examples, legal); a workflow using AI for first-pass translation plus a glossary and brand-voice prompt, then human review; hreflang and multilingual SEO so pages rank in each market; keyword research per language (search intent differs); QA for cultural missteps. Measuring whether localized pages convert. Claims to verify: current hreflang guidance and multilingual indexing behaviour; machine-translation-at-scale quality caveats from Google. Sources: Google Search Central multilingual docs; a localization-quality study. Distinct from the consumer Gemini Live Translate post.

topics.titleTr: Yasam Dongusu E-postasi: Karsilama ve Geri Kazanma
topics.titleEn: Lifecycle Email: Onboarding to Win-Back Flows
topics.angle: guide | design the automated email flows that actually move revenue
topics.brief: Outline: beyond broadcasts, the core automated flows (welcome/onboarding, activation nudges, abandoned cart/browse, post-purchase, re-engagement, win-back); what each should say and when to send; segmentation and triggers; writing for the first-reader-is-an-AI inbox and deliverability basics; metrics per flow (open proxy issues post-MPP, click, revenue). A small-brand build order. Claims to verify: current open-rate reliability after Apple MPP; deliverability authentication basics. Sources: ESP lifecycle guides; email deliverability references. Distinct from list-building and deliverability posts already live.

topics.titleTr: Donusturen Fiyatlandirma Sayfasi Tasarimi
topics.titleEn: Pricing Page Design That Converts
topics.angle: mistakes | the pricing-page errors that cost signups and how to fix them
topics.brief: Outline: the pricing page as a decision moment, not a table; common mistakes (too many tiers, jargon feature lists, hidden CTA, no anchor, decision paralysis); proven patterns (3 tiers, highlighted plan, annual toggle, social proof, FAQ handling objections); clarity on usage/overage in an AI-pricing world; accessibility and mobile. How to test changes safely. Claims to verify: choice-overload and anchoring effects; any current CRO benchmarks (cite cautiously). Sources: NN/g pricing-page research; a CRO case study. Complement existing landing-page and comparison-page posts without repeating them.

topics.titleTr: 2026 YouTube SEO: Videolarinizi Ust Siralara Tasiyin
topics.titleEn: YouTube SEO: Rank Your Videos in 2026
topics.angle: checklist | optimize titles, metadata and retention so videos get recommended and found
topics.brief: Outline: how YouTube search and suggested differ from Google SEO; keyword and topic research (YouTube search, Google Trends, autocomplete); titles, descriptions, chapters and transcripts that help discovery; thumbnails and CTR; the retention signals that actually drive reach; using AI to draft metadata and chapter outlines from a transcript; appearing in Google video results. Claims to verify: current ranking-signal guidance from YouTube/Google and transcript indexing. Sources: YouTube Creators ranking docs; Google Search video best practices. Position as video-SEO, distinct from the channel-growth post in social.

topics.titleTr: Telefon Bataryasi Neden Eskir ve Nasil Yavaslatilir
topics.titleEn: Why Your Phone Battery Degrades (and How to Slow It)
topics.angle: mistakes | the charging habits that age your battery and the ones that actually help
topics.brief: Outline: how lithium-ion aging works (charge cycles, heat, voltage stress); myth-busting (overnight charging, draining to 0, fast charging, closing apps); what helps (80% charge caps, avoiding heat, optimized/adaptive charging, keeping it mid-range); reading battery health on iOS and Android; when replacement beats a new phone; e-waste angle. Claims to verify: 80% longevity guidance, heat effects, and OS adaptive-charging behaviour from manufacturer docs. Sources: Apple battery and performance support; Android/Pixel battery guidance. Practical, evergreen consumer explainer.

topics.titleTr: 2026da Hala VPN Gerekli mi?
topics.titleEn: Do You Still Need a VPN in 2026?
topics.angle: guide | cut through VPN marketing and decide when one actually helps
topics.brief: Outline: what a VPN does and doesn't do now that most of the web is HTTPS; legitimate uses (public Wi-Fi caution, bypassing geo-blocks, hiding IP from sites, ISP tracking, travel) vs overblown fears; the trust shift from ISP to VPN provider (logging, jurisdiction, audits); free-VPN risks; alternatives (encrypted DNS, passkeys, Apple Private Relay). How to pick one if you need it. Claims to verify: HTTPS adoption share and any independent VPN no-logs audit findings. Sources: Mozilla/Cloudflare HTTPS stats; a reputable VPN audit report. Skeptical, practical tone.

topics.titleTr: Dijital Hayatinizi Yedekleyin: 3-2-1 Plani
topics.titleEn: Back Up Your Digital Life: A 3-2-1 Plan
topics.angle: checklist | protect photos and documents against loss, theft and ransomware
topics.brief: Outline: the 3-2-1 rule (three copies, two media, one offsite) in plain terms; why cloud sync is not a backup; a concrete setup (local external drive + encrypted cloud backup + periodic offline copy) for phone and computer; protecting against ransomware and account lockout with versioning and a recovery kit; testing a restore. A short story of a lost-photos scare. Claims to verify: sync-vs-backup distinction and ransomware versioning behaviour of major services. Sources: backup best-practice guides; provider versioning docs. Consumer-focused, distinct from the server/DB disaster-recovery posts.

topics.titleTr: GaN Sarj ve USB-C PD: Daha Akilli Satin Alin
topics.titleEn: GaN Chargers and USB-C PD: Buy Smarter
topics.angle: guide | decode wattage, PD and PPS so one charger powers everything
topics.brief: Outline: why GaN chargers are smaller and cooler; reading USB-C Power Delivery (PD), PPS and wattage so a phone, tablet and laptop share one brick; what fast charging your devices actually negotiate; cable ratings (3A vs 5A, e-marked, USB-IF certification) and why a bad cable throttles or risks damage; travel and multi-port picks. Claims to verify: current USB-PD/PPS spec basics and USB-IF certification guidance. Sources: USB-IF Power Delivery resources; a reputable charger-testing site. Buyer-friendly, jargon-busting consumer guide.

topics.titleTr: 2026: Parola Yoneticisi mi, Passkey mi?
topics.titleEn: Password Managers vs Passkeys in 2026
topics.angle: comparison | where passkeys replace passwords and where a manager still earns its keep
topics.brief: Outline: how passkeys work (device-bound vs synced) and why they beat passwords on phishing; where you still need a password manager (legacy sites, shared logins, secure notes, TOTP, cross-ecosystem sync); whether your manager now stores passkeys too; account recovery and lock-in worries; a practical migration order for a non-technical reader. Claims to verify: current passkey sync and recovery behaviour across Apple, Google and major managers. Sources: FIDO Alliance passkeys resources; manager passkey docs. Builds on the existing passkeys how-tos with a decision angle, not a repeat.

topics.titleTr: Musteri Gorusmelerini Yapay Zeka ile Sentezleyin
topics.titleEn: Synthesize Customer Interviews With AI
topics.angle: how-to | turn raw interview notes into themes and decisions without fooling yourself
topics.brief: Outline: why founders drown in interview notes and cherry-pick; a workflow to transcribe, tag and cluster findings with AI while guarding against confirmation bias and hallucinated patterns; prompting for disconfirming evidence and verbatim quotes; separating what people say from what they do; turning themes into a prioritized problem list and next experiments. Privacy for recordings and consent. Claims to verify: interview-bias pitfalls (The Mom Test principles) and safe handling of PII. Sources: The Mom Test (Fitzpatrick); a research-synthesis method guide. Complements the existing Mom Test post with an AI-assisted method.

topics.titleTr: Yapay Zeka ile Daha Hizli Ise Alim: Ilandan Elemeye
topics.titleEn: Hire Faster With AI: JDs to Screening
topics.angle: guide | speed up small-team hiring with AI while staying fair and legal
topics.brief: Outline: where AI safely saves time (drafting job descriptions, structuring scorecards, writing take-home prompts, summarizing applications) vs where it creates legal and bias risk (automated rejection, resume scoring); building a structured, criteria-first process; keeping a human decision and audit trail; writing inclusive JDs; candidate experience. Claims to verify: hiring-bias and adverse-impact risks of AI screening and relevant rules (EEOC/EU AI Act high-risk classification for hiring). Sources: EEOC guidance on AI in hiring; EU AI Act hiring provisions. Distinct from the hire-a-person-vs-agent post.

topics.titleTr: Ilk Haftada Aktive Eden SaaS Karsilama Deneyimi
topics.titleEn: SaaS Onboarding That Activates Users in Week One
topics.angle: how-to | get new signups to their aha moment before they churn
topics.brief: Outline: why most trials churn in the first session; defining your activation metric and the shortest path to first value; mapping the signup-to-aha journey and removing steps; onboarding patterns (checklist, empty states, templates/sample data, contextual nudges, not a forced tour); lifecycle emails that bring people back; measuring activation and time-to-value. A before/after on a leaky flow. Claims to verify: activation-vs-retention linkage and common time-to-value benchmarks (cite cautiously). Sources: product-led growth/onboarding references (e.g. Reforge/Appcues writing). Distinct from the churn-retention and first-metrics posts.
